Pinus Pengger Guide

A Guide to Choosing Dlingo Pine Spots

Kalurahan Terong lists several Dlingo pine destinations. This page helps pick the most suitable without visiting them all.

Updated 28 October 2026

Detail

Spots in one belt

Pinus Pengger, Puncak Becici and Hutan Pinus Mangunan are in the Dlingo pine belt. This allows a half-day route.

Detail

How to choose

  • Decide preference: installation photos (Pengger) or panorama variety (Becici/Mangunan).
  • Fit with time: pick 2–3 nearest.
  • Use your own vehicle for flexibility.

Detail

Avoid stacking

Do not force all spots in one day. Pick the most suitable and save the rest for next time.

Choose by genuine preference, not just a list.

Frequently asked questions

How many Dlingo pine spots are there?

Terong village documentation mentions Pengger, Becici, Mangunan and Pinus Asri as pine destinations.

Must I visit all?

No. Pick 2–3 nearest per day; save the rest for next time.

Which is most iconic?

Pinus Pengger is known for its giant-hand installation; Becici/Mangunan for panorama variety.

Is a guide needed?

Not required; a map and asking staff suffice.
